newsitem.title: USA: PG&E Calif. nuclear unit seen up Mon night.
newsitem.headline: PG&E Calif. nuclear unit seen up Mon night.

text.p: Pacific Gas and Electric Co's 1,087 megawatt (MW) Diablo Canyon nuclear unit 1 is expected to begin ramping up late Monday afternoon, and to reach full power before midnight, a company spokesman said.
The Avila Beach, Calif., unit was reduced to about 50 percent power Sunday night for condenser cleaning.
PG&E said earlier Monday that the unit would be back to full power by mid-afternoon, but the schedule was slightly delayed.
"This is a very short-term curtailment," the company spokesman said. "It will be about 24 hours between the time the unit was ramped down to the time it reaches 100 percent power."
